title: Release handoff and client quarantine notes (solo)
content:
Context:
- Preparing handoff for deploy v2024.5.2 to two key enterprise clients (AcmeCo, NovaHealth). They requested a temporary client-specific quarantine window to observe outputs for 48h before full unpin. This doc = my personal runbook + checklist + open questions.

High level plan (rough):
1) Deploy canary -> internal + 1% pilot tenants (non-sensitive). Smoke for 1h.
2) If green, push to client-quarantine cohort (AcmeCo + NovaHealth routed to quarantined model variant). Quarantine = mirrored requests go to quarantined instance but only returns to logs and CS dashboard (not to client) for first 30m to sanity-check outputs.
3) After mirrored sanity, flip to returning responses to client but with explicit "experimental" flag in header for 24h. Monitor quality signals closely.
4) If no regressions, gradually increase exposure (50% -> 100%) over 24–48h and unpin.

Pre-handoff checklist (things I will run through before paging ops):
- Confirm model artifact tag: rwd-model-v1.14-qt8 (sha abc123).
- Verify quantization profile applied matches perf regression test (bench id bench/2024-04-28-q8).
- Confirm fallback model registered (rwd-model-v1.13) and routing policy set.
- Create targeted telemetry views (see queries below) and share with CS + SRE.
- Reserve quiet window (low-traffic slot) in region-us-west1 02:00–04:00 PT (agreed with SRE).
- Upload canary rollout schedule to Confluence and ping stakeholders in #deploys.

Quarantine cohort details (notes):
- Cohort = AcmeCo (tenant id t-acme-001) and NovaHealth (t-nh-22).
- Isolation: route traffic via routing policy "client-quarantine-yr" to model cluster qc-usw-2.
- Mirroring: initial 30m mirror-only to avoid exposing unreviewed outputs. Archive mirrored payloads for adhoc evals.
- Client comms: give concise phrasing "We are running a controlled evaluation for 48 hours; you may see experimental outputs. Please send any concerns to your CSM."

Signals and thresholds (quick):
- Latency p95 <= 210ms (if > 300ms for 5m, trigger fallback to previous model).
- Error rate (5xx) <= 0.2% (if > 0.5% for 2m, rollback).
- Output-quality regressions flagged by eval-run: drop in BLEU-like score > 4 points or spike in hallucination rate > 3x baseline -> immediate pause.
- Manual CS flags: any client-reported false-positive/unsafe output -> pause and triage.

Quick queries to create (ad-hoc)
- tokens_per_request by tenant over last 1h -> look for explosion after model change.
- p95 latency by route for qc-usw-2 vs fallback cluster.
- new error types in logs: search for "decode_error" or "kv-cache-miss"
- mirror-consistency: side-by-side diffs of model v1.14 vs v1.13 on sample prompt-set (stored at s3://rwd-samples/quarantine-acme)

Rollback matrix (simple):
1) Soft pause: revert routing for quarantine cohort to mirror-only and notify CS + SRE.
2) Hard rollback: switch routing to fallback model v1.13 pinned and rollout cancellation.
3) Postmortem: gather top 20 failing prompts, reproduction script, perf traces (open a ticket and tag release-responses).

Communication snippets (copy-paste for Slack/email):
- To #deploys: "Starting targeted quarantine for AcmeCo+NovaHealth at 02:15 PT. Mirror-only for first 30m; watch p95 and 5xx dashboards. Pager on-call if thresholds exceeded."
- To CSMs: "Client quarantine live; we are mirroring outputs for 30m then returning results with experimental header for 24h. Please escalate any client concerns immediately to me (Priya)."

Notes to self / loose thoughts:
- Consider adding lightweight randomized sampling of client prompts to dedicated eval runner (so we don't rely solely on CS flags).
- If mirror logs contain PII, ensure redaction pipeline is applied before handing to reviewers.
- Might be worth a short script to auto-generate per-tenant diff reports (top tokens changed, top prompt categories regressed).

Open questions / decisions pending:
- Do we require legal sign-off for NovaHealth because of PHI risk? (talk to Alyssa in security).
- Should we enable the new aggressive KV cache eviction setting for qc cluster? It reduces memory but might increase latency variability. Default = off.
- Decide whether to bake a per-client SLA exception during quarantine.

TODO (actionable):
- [ ] Create the telemetry dashboards and grant read to CSMs (deadline: today EOD).
- [ ] Register routing policy + test dry-run in staging (me).
- [ ] Draft client email and run by Emily (CS lead).
- [ ] Validate data retention settings for mirrored payloads (SRE).

References / quick links:
- release notes PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/678
- quarantine sample prompts: s3://rwd-samples/quarantine-acme
- staging runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/RELEASE/pages/98765

End-of-file mini-postmortem template (copy into ticket if needed):
- Summary:
- Time of change:
- Clients affected:
- Triggering signal:
- Root cause hypothesis:
- Steps taken (soft pause -> rollback):
- Follow-ups (owners + due dates):

(Loose brainstorming, keep this doc personal. Will refine into a proper handoff doc once we run one quarantine end-to-end.)
